topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Under § 12-10-211(1), what happens automatically if a licensee changes business address or employment without notifying the commission?
choice_a: The licensee's license is automatically inactivated
choice_c: The licensee's license is automatically revoked
choice_d: Nothing, as long as the change is reported within 60 days
explanation: The statute states: "A change of business address or employment without notification to the commission shall automatically inactivate the licensee's license."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: When a broker transfers to the address of another broker and becomes employed by that broker, who has control and custody of the employed broker's license under § 12-10-211(2)?
choice_d: Custody is shared jointly between both brokers
explanation: The text specifies: "The employing broker shall have the control and custody of the employed broker's license."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: If a licensee is discharged by or terminates employment with a broker, § 12-10-211(3) states that the duty to immediately notify the commission is:
choice_b: The joint duty of both parties
choice_c: Only required if the licensee requests it
explanation: The statute provides: "it shall be the joint duty of both such parties to immediately notify the commission."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Per § 12-10-211(4), for the same period of time, how many employers or places of employment may be shown in commission records for a given real estate broker?
choice_a: Two, if both are disclosed in writing
choice_b: As many as the broker actually worked for that year
explanation: The text states: "Not more than one employer or place of employment shall be shown for any real estate broker for the same period of time."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: An applicant is issued an initial Colorado broker's license on May 1, 2018. Under § 12-10-212(4)(a)(I), when does this initial license expire?
choice_d: It does not expire until reinstatement is requested
explanation: The statute makes an exception to the standard three-year cycle: "an initial license issued under this part 2 on or after April 23, 2018, expires at 12 midnight on December 31 of the year in which it was issued."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Under § 12-10-212(4)(a)(II), applications for license renewal will be accepted how many days prior to January 1?
explanation: The statute states plainly: "Applications for renewal will be accepted thirty days prior to January 1."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Under Commission Rule 3.11.B.3.a, a broker (whether on Active or Inactive status) may begin submitting a renewal application how many days prior to the expiration date of the license?
explanation: Rule 3.11.B.3.a states: "All Brokers, whether on Active or Inactive status, may renew their License beginning forty-five (45) days prior to the expiration date of their License."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: A broker's license expired on June 1. She submits a proper renewal application on June 20 (within 31 days of expiration). Under § 12-10-212(4)(a)(III)(A), what must she pay to reinstate the license?
choice_b: The regular renewal fee plus a reinstatement fee equal to half the renewal fee
choice_c: The regular renewal fee plus a reinstatement fee equal to the full renewal fee
choice_d: A brand-new application fee, since the license lapsed
explanation: The statute provides that reinstatement "If proper application is made within thirty-one days after the date of expiration, by payment of the regular renewal fee" only.

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: A broker's license expired on January 15. He applies for reinstatement on May 1 of the same year — more than 31 days but less than one year after expiration. Under § 12-10-212(4)(a)(III)(B), what fee must he pay?
choice_a: The regular renewal fee plus a reinstatement fee equal to the full renewal fee
choice_c: A reinstatement fee only, with no renewal fee
choice_d: The regular renewal fee plus a reinstatement fee equal to one-half the regular renewal fee
explanation: The statute states that in this window reinstatement occurs "by payment of the regular renewal fee and payment of a reinstatement fee equal to one-half the regular renewal fee."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: A broker's license expired two years ago and she is now applying for reinstatement (more than one year but within three years after expiration). Under § 12-10-212(4)(a)(III)(C), what must she pay?
choice_b: The regular renewal fee plus a reinstatement fee equal to the regular renewal fee
choice_c: A flat reinstatement fee with no renewal fee
choice_d: She cannot reinstate and must reapply as a new applicant
explanation: The statute provides that in this window reinstatement occurs "by payment of the regular renewal fee and payment of a reinstatement fee equal to the regular renewal fee."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Under § 12-10-212(4)(b), a person who fails to apply for reinstatement within three years after the expiration of a license will be treated as:
choice_a: Eligible for a further one-year grace period
choice_c: A new applicant for licensure, without exception
explanation: The statute is explicit: "Any person who fails to apply for reinstatement within three years after the expiration of a license shall, without exception, be treated as a new applicant for licensure."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Under § 12-10-212(2), a person who passes the broker's examination must file the appropriate broker's application within what time frame, or the passing score is automatically terminated?
choice_a: One year of the date the person passed the examination
choice_b: Six months of the date the person passed the examination
choice_c: Ninety days of the date the person passed the examination
choice_d: Two years of the date the person passed the examination
explanation: The statute states: "Failure by the person taking an examination to file the appropriate broker's application within one year of the date the person passed the examination will automatically cancel the examination, and all rights to a passing score will be terminated."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Under § 12-10-212(5), if a real estate broker's license is suspended, expired, or revoked, what happens to the licenses of brokers shown in commission records as employed by that broker?
choice_a: They remain fully active until the next renewal cycle
choice_b: They are automatically upgraded to independent broker status
choice_c: The commission must hold a hearing before taking any action
choice_d: Their licenses are automatically inactivated, pending notification to the commission of a change of employment
explanation: The statute states that such an event "shall automatically inactivate every real estate broker's license where the holder of the license is shown in the commission records to be in the employ of the broker whose license has expired or has been suspended or revoked pending notification to the commission by the employed licensee of a change of employment."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Under § 12-10-215(2)(a)(II), the annual registration fee for the HOA information and resource center, paid from the division of real estate cash fund, is subject to what maximum limit?
explanation: The statute states: "The amount of the registration fee shall be sufficient to recover these costs, subject to a maximum limit of fifty dollars."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Per § 12-10-215(3)(a), on June 30, 2025, the state treasurer was required to transfer how much money from the division of real estate cash fund to the general fund?
explanation: The statute states: "on June 30, 2025, the state treasurer shall transfer two hundred thousand dollars from the division of real estate cash fund to the general fund."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Under Commission Rule 3.10, every Independent Broker or Employing Broker residing in Colorado must maintain a place of business in the state, except for:
choice_a: Associate Brokers or Brokers registered as Inactive
choice_b: Brokers who have been licensed for less than one year
choice_c: Brokers who work exclusively in commercial real estate
explanation: Rule 3.10 states: "Every Independent Broker or Employing Broker residing in Colorado must maintain a place of business in this State, except for Associate Brokers or Brokers registered as Inactive."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Under Commission Rule 3.11.A, do Brokerage Firms themselves have to renew their license?
choice_b: Yes, on the same calendar-year cycle as their brokers
choice_c: Yes, but only if they are inactive
choice_d: No, Brokerage Firms are not required to renew their License, though the associated Independent or Employing Broker must renew
explanation: Rule 3.11.A states: "Brokerage Firms are not required to renew their License; however, the Independent Broker or Employing Broker associated with the Brokerage Firm must renew as set forth in Rule 3.11.B."

topic: License Renewal, Status Changes, and Fees
question: Under Rule 3.15.B (Transition Period License Reinstatement), for a broker whose license was initially issued before January 1, 2018, if a proper application to reinstate is made more than 31 days but within one year after expiration, what expiration date will the reinstated license carry?
choice_a: The original anniversary date from the year of initial issuance
choice_b: December 31 of the year of issuance (the year of reinstatement)
choice_c: Three years from the date of reinstatement
choice_d: December 31, three years after the original expiration date
explanation: Rule 3.15.B states that in this window, upon payment of the renewal fee and a reinstatement fee equal to one-half the renewal fee, "the License will be issued with an expiration date of December 31 of the year of issuance."
